issue_context.title: Exceptions from EventRecordWrittenEventArgs are missing the original win32 error code
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. If you have write-permissions please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).

I see that the `EventLogException` ([EventLogException.cs#L23](https://github.com/microsoft/referencesource/blob/5697c29004a34d80acdaf5742d7e699022c64ecd/System.Core/System/Diagnostics/Eventing/Reader/EventLogException.cs#L23)) actually converts the `errorCode` to exceptions but as error 6 isn't among those converted the error code is lost since there is no method from which to retrieve the error code.

review_comments:
as an aside, it would be nice to comment all the error codes in this file, eg.,
```
                case 2: // ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
                case 3: // ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND
                case 15007: // ERROR_EVT_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND
                case 15027: // ERROR_EVT_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND
```
etc

Can you please fix formatting here -- braces on their own line, etc.

Also, I believe this should be `HResult = Win32Marshal.MakeHRFromErrorCode(errorCode);`
